name: haticons
description: A set of beautifully crafted, modular, lightweight web font and SVG icons for Web, iOS, Android, and Desktop apps. Inspired by Ionicons, FontAwesome, and Glyphicons.

scripts.test: node -e "const h = require('./index.js'); const cart = require('./dist/icons/cart.js'); const snap = h.getIcon('snapchat'); const reactIcon = h.getIcon('react'); const xAlias = h.getIcon('x'); const cursor = h.getIcon('cursor'); const trae = h.getIcon('trae'); const anti = h.getIcon('antigravity'); const boodoo = h.getIcon('boodoo'); const windsurf = h.getIcon('windsurf'); const claude = h.getIcon('claude'); const gemini = h.getIcon('gemini'); const cusror = h.getIcon('cusror'); const antogravity = h.getIcon('antogravity'); console.log('Icons count (CJS):', h.icons.length, 'Verified Brands:', [cursor, trae, anti, boodoo, windsurf, claude, gemini, cusror, antogravity].every(Boolean)); if (h.icons.length !== 569 || cart.name !== 'cart' || !snap || snap.name !== 'spanchat' || !reactIcon || !xAlias || !cursor || !trae || !anti || !boodoo || !windsurf || !claude || !gemini || !cusror || !antogravity) process.exit(1);" && node --input-type=module -e "import { icons, getIcon } from './index.mjs'; import cart from './dist/icons/cart.mjs'; const cursor = getIcon('cursor'); const trae = getIcon('trae'); const anti = getIcon('antigravity'); const boodoo = getIcon('boodoo'); const windsurf = getIcon('windsurf'); const claude = getIcon('claude'); const gemini = getIcon('gemini'); console.log('Icons count (ESM):', icons.length, 'Verified ESM:', [cursor, trae, anti, boodoo, windsurf, claude, gemini].every(Boolean)); if (icons.length !== 569 || cart.name !== 'cart' || !cursor || !trae || !anti || !boodoo || !windsurf || !claude || !gemini) process.exit(1);"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run test && npm run build
